cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Understand the Hurt
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge why their action hurt, not merely agree that it happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. I saved you a front-row seat at my concert. Do you understand why it hurt?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I told you work might run late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. I knew. I still looked at that empty seat before every song.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You needed someone there who knew what this meant to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. You'd heard me practise for months. Please tell me you understand why someone else couldn't fill it.

mechanism: A copies a concert-list mark as evidence of attendance without understanding it and asks B to recognize the hurt of absence.
confusable: D99 asks why action hurt; D75 can seek broader recognition of personal cost.
comparison: Empty concert seat versus dinner text after job loss.
seedUse: Keep B recognizing special witness role, with exact list correction not an unstated recording.
